report.root_cause: At 06:41:44, plugins/StatsCache/config.yml was changed to retain-history: true, and StatsCache hot-reloaded it at 06:41:45. With history retained, the StatsCache history cache grew without bound and ignored its history-size: 1000 cap (1154+ entries, about 330 MB). The heap went from about 349 MB to 692 of 768 MB in about 90 s.
report.actions: 1. Watched status and saw the heap climbing steadily while TPS stayed normal. 2. Read the logs and found the StatsCache config reload with retain-history=true at 06:41:45. 3. Read plugins/StatsCache/config.yml and declared the incident. 4. Ran 'statscache stats' twice: 846 entries (~242 MB), then 1154 entries (~330 MB), which is past the history-size limit. 5. Rewrote plugins/StatsCache/config.yml with retain-history: false (history-size: 1000 left as it was). The plugin hot-reloaded it at 06:42:49 (retain-history=false). 6. Ran 'statscache flush', which freed 1252 entries (~358 MB). The heap fell to about 296 MB. 7. Checked for about 150 s afterwards: StatsCache stayed at 28 entries / ~8 MB with retain-history=false, TPS was about 20, all plugins enabled, both players online. No restart, no bans, no deletions.
report.residual_risk: The StatsCache history cache stopped growing after the fix (stable at 28 entries). The heap still rose slowly after the flush, from about 296 to 437 MB over about 150 s, but no GC drop had happened yet in that time, so this may be normal allocation that GC will clear. Keep watching it. The bug is still in the plugin: with retain-history enabled, StatsCache ignores history-size, so turning retain-history back on will cause the leak again until the plugin is fixed. Someone made the config change at 06:41:44 and whoever did it should be told it was reverted.
